# Abyss audio credits

Every sound in this folder is cut from a field or foley recording that its author released into the public domain.
No attribution is required for any of them; the authors are credited here with thanks.
`tools/abyss-audio.json` holds the exact excerpt and processing of each file, and `tools/place-audio.py --set abyss` rebuilds them.

## Files

- `reef.mp3` is cut from "Underwater crackling sounds_Hydrophone.wav" by KaleidacousticsAudio, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/KaleidacousticsAudio/sounds/630436/.
- `rush.mp3` is cut from "Underwater Movement.wav" by Tim_Verberne, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/Tim_Verberne/sounds/484187/.
- `whale_1.mp3` is cut from "Diving with whales.wav" by KEVOY, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/KEVOY/sounds/82325/.
- `whale_2.mp3` is cut from "Diving with whales.wav" by KEVOY, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/KEVOY/sounds/82325/.
